mapper.sql: id, session_id, aid, title, status, is_debug, pin_order, create_user_id, is_deleted, create_time, modify_time
mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_session (session_id, aid, title, status, is_debug, pin_order, create_user_id, is_deleted) values (#{sessionId}, #{aid}, #{title}, #{status}, #{isDebug}, #{pinOrder}, #{createUserId}, 0)
mapper.select: select from ai_agent_session where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
select from ai_agent_session where session_id = #{sessionId} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
select from ai_agent_session where session_id = #{sessionId} and aid = #{aid} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
select max(pin_order) from ai_agent_session where is_deleted = 0 and create_user_id = #{createUserId}
